tezera attendee flow

Desktop web portal screens for the attendee (consumer) account, covering every branch of the consumer mind map. Use the flow map to see each journey end to end, or click through the screens: highlighted areas are real links.

About these screens
  • Palette is the Attendee palette from brand manual v1.1: coral #D77E70 primary, pink #F09EB4 secondary, yellow #E5C76C accent on #F7F0ED. Dark uses the manual's attendee dark set (#8F3628 on #120B08).
  • Small tags on screens (Should, Could, Proposed, To decide) carry the priority notes from the mind map.
  • Yellow hotspots show a message instead of changing screen (for example Apply or Mark received). Download SVG saves the current screen so it can be dropped into Figma.
